title: Manifesto
lines: PLACEHOLDER 1 — We begin small, and that is enough.
PLACEHOLDER 2 — We reach towards the light together.
PLACEHOLDER 3 — We make space for what needs to grow.
PLACEHOLDER 4 — We hold each other up.
PLACEHOLDER 5 — We protect what is tender.
PLACEHOLDER 6 — We let things breathe and drain away.
PLACEHOLDER 7 — We feed what we hope will flourish.
PLACEHOLDER 8 — We welcome every small visitor.
